label: preparing
what: A surprise jubilee tribute/feast for the mayor in the great hall at eighteen on day 1: replacing 200 mouldy loaves with 200 fresh ones, installing eight lanterns, and bringing the mayor under the cover of a lighting inspection. Baker knowingly baked, lent funds, delivered bread and promised secrecy. Neighbour knowingly offered confidential grain-credit message help, but is not shown knowing the jubilee purpose; secretary arranged an authorized escort without demonstrated knowledge of the surprise. Mayor learned about the bread and jubilee wording later, but is not shown being told that the tribute was for him.
